senses.gloss: घुण् vi. 1Ā, 6P (pp. घुणित) To roll, to whirl, to turn round.
घुण् (II) vt. 1Ā (pp. घुणित) To take, to receive.
घुण m. A particular kind of insect found in timber.
घुण-अक्षर n. an incision in wood or in the leaf of a book made by an insect or worm and resembling somewhat the form of a letter.

घुण-अक्षर˚न्याय m. the maxim of letters bored by an insect in wood. It indicates any chance occurrence, taking its origin in the unexpected, and chance resemblance of an incision made by an insect to the form of a letter.
